cases.sentence: Пусть тот, кто чист, соберет пепел телицы и положит его на ___ вне лагеря.
cases.explain: «чистом месте» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.

cases.sentence: Любой, кто прикоснется к мертвому ___, будет нечист семь дней.
cases.explain: «человеческому телу» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

cases.sentence: Пусть он очистит себя водой на третий и на ___; потом он будет чист.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

cases.sentence: Но если он не очистит себя на третий и на ___, он не будет чист.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

cases.sentence: Любой, кто прикоснулся к мертвому ___ и не очистился, оскверняет скинию Господа.
cases.explain: «человеческому телу» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles Yahweh’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.

cases.sentence: Пусть для ___ положат в сосуд пепел от сожженного очистительного приношения и нальют сверху свежей воды.
cases.explain: «нечистого человека» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel.

cases.sentence: Пусть для нечистого человека положат в сосуд пепел от сожженного ___ и нальют сверху свежей воды.
cases.explain: «очистительного приношения» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel.

cases.sentence: Пусть для нечистого человека положат в сосуд пепел от сожженного очистительного приношения и нальют сверху ___.
cases.explain: «свежей воды» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel.

cases.sentence: Пусть тот, кто чист, окропит ___ на третий и на седьмой день; так он очистит его на седьмой день.
cases.explain: «нечистого человека» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

cases.sentence: Пусть тот, кто чист, окропит нечистого человека на третий и на ___; так он очистит его на седьмой день.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

cases.sentence: Пусть тот, кто чист, окропит нечистого человека на третий и на ___; так он очистит его на седьмой день.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

cases.sentence: Все, к чему прикоснется ___, станет нечистым, и любой, кто прикоснется к этому, станет нечистым до вечера.
cases.explain: «нечистый человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”
